recentItems.title: What could deeper ties with the EU mean for Canada's sovereignty?
recentItems.description:
Chief political correspondent Rosemary Barton speaks with Jonathan Wilkinson, Canada's ambassador-designate to the European Union, about what the government is seeking from Canada's burgeoning relationship with the EU. Plus, president of the European Investment Bank Nadia Calviño discusses her visit to Ottawa. Then, Latvian MEP Rihards Kols and former U.S. trade representative Katherine Tai give their perspectives on EU-Canada relations. Finally, a Canadian business owner on receiving federal funding to expand business in Europe.
